areas.name: Downtown
areas.blurb: Main Street from San Francisco Avenue up past State Street, and Commercial Street east past the Skunk Train depot: cafes and pubs, the movie theater, City Hall, the library and county museum, and the Frontier Days rodeo grounds.

areas.name: North Main & Sherwood Road
areas.blurb: North Main Street above State Street toward the north Highway 101 interchange: the high school, light industry on North Lenore Avenue and the foot of Sherwood Road.

areas.name: South Main & Highway 20
areas.blurb: South Main Street from San Francisco Avenue down past the Highway 20 turn for Fort Bragg and the Willits Arch: supermarkets, gas stations, motels and diners, with Blosser Lane, the schools and the Sherwood Valley Rancheria to the west.

areas.name: South End & Baechtel Road
areas.blurb: The south end of Main Street toward the Highway 101 interchange: shopping centers, chain motels and fast food, Baechtel and East Hill Roads, and Howard Memorial Hospital.

areas.name: Brooktrails
areas.blurb: The wooded township in the hills northwest of town, up Sherwood Road: redwood and fir forest, the golf course, the trails of Brooktrails Redwood Park and the fire station.

areas.name: Around Willits
areas.blurb: Spots elsewhere in ZIP 95490: Little Lake Valley ranch roads, Hearst Willits Road and the east side, Ridgewood Ranch and Highway 101 south, Sherwood Valley and Longvale, and the hills beyond town. Contractors and other trades that work across the area are listed here too.
